assertions: Official review guidance requires every supported feature selected on the store page to be implemented in the current build.
A future feature must remain unselected until it is implemented and released.
A valid current-build fixture produces a stable revision across preparation times.
Changing build, catalog, feature identity, display name, implementation evidence or test evidence changes the revision hash.
Planned, unknown and duplicate feature declarations are blocked rather than silently accepted.
Current platform availability, catalog mapping, evidence quality, actual usability and owned-target authority remain pending human review.
The result cannot claim build validation, Steamworks save, preview, publication, review submission, release or execution authorization.
